name: Ferdinand
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Ferdinand in Innsbruck!**

Discover the heart of the Alps in **Tirol**, where tradition meets adventure. At **Ferdinand**, we invite you to experience authentic Austrian hospitality in the charming city of **Innsbruck**, the capital of **Tirol**.

Indulge in our famous **Kaiserschmarrn**—fluffy, caramelized, and served with fresh fruit or a dollop of apricot jam. Pair it with a steaming cup of **Melange** or a crisp **Radler** for the perfect start to your day.

Explore the historic **Altstadt**, stroll along the **Inn River**, or take the cable car up to **Nordkette** for breathtaking views of the **Zillertal Alps**. Whether you're here for culture, nature, or culinary delights, **Ferdinand** is your gateway to unforgettable moments in **Tirol**.

Come as a guest, leave as a friend—**Tirol** awaits!
